steps.note: The plan traces scratch values a,c through rows 0-7 and concludes the net change (JV+RG)x is independent of a,c because rows 6-7 restore them, as the paper does.
The plan states the bit-case central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, the side wires cancelling exactly the intersection-one cases, and self coefficient one.
The plan never states the complex-case central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2 or that the side wires cancel intersections zero and two.
The plan gives the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) with each invocation restoring its own scratch wires.
S2.3.1.3.4 only names 'listing every edge's orthogonal residual' and gives the central 3->4 residual; the per-edge residuals and dimensions of the table are not stated.
S2.3.1.3.3 states the inclusion P(x)<t_X> in P(x)t_Y^perp from t_X perp t_Y (the label construction at line 953), but not the side edge 2->5 residual <t_X,t_Y>^perp of dimension h-2.
The plan states the only decreasing edge is center 3->4 losing h, and the telescoping with sources N, sinks Wm-N, signed Wm-2N and absolute adding 2L.
The plan uses an 'orthonormal residual basis' but never argues that each nonzero binary residual is nondegenerate and nonalternating, or absorbs alternating planes.
The plan states L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539.
The plan derives weight additivity mod 4 for orthogonal binary vectors and that q_V-q_U is a sum over an orthonormal residual basis of terms in [v.x].

S2.4.1.1 asserts each phase i^{+-[v.x]} becomes aI+bX_v after Hadamard conjugation, but omits that wt(v) is odd (which is why the coefficient is +-1) and the identity H diag(1,-1) H = X; marked absent as the reason is not given.
The plan states one kernel per residual basis vector applied as (C^{+-1})^{tensor f} over the f axes of a slot, giving s_c child calls in all.

The plan only says 'after the source and sink sign corrections' (S2.4.1.5); it never gives the endpoint frames I and C^{tensor m}, the C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a) repaired by Z_{a,k} and i^{27k}Z_{a,k}, or the negation of X outputs.
The plan states that L_b<N/2 makes the deficit N-2L_b>0 so s_b<W_b m, and similarly 2N-2L_c>0 for the complex network.
The plan states eta_b=339/22587335000000.
The value eta_c=73/19906842167500 appears nowhere in the plan.

The plan gives the chain: the deficit exceeds 20*2^{-50} and log m<20, so m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20*2^{-50})>m(1-eta), giving s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}; it does so for the binary network only, and the complex bound s/W<=m^sigma (S2.4.5.2) is asserted without this argument.

The plan states the pivot at the rightmost nonzero entry of the topmost nonzero row, clearing by lower-triangular elementary operations, giving A=E_1 Pi E_2 with Pi having a ones; repetition on active indices is implicit.
The plan states the prime q avoids all denominators so the triangular factors stay invertible modulo q^b.
The plan states a lower-triangular change costs O(V) by updating in descending physical order, earlier coordinates still holding their original values.
The plan states D_j<-D_j+H_i, interchange, D_j<-H_i-D_j, one interchange per one of Pi, a in all.
The plan names C_0 d^{C_1}, C_1=20 and Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) but never defines E=64(W+m+1)^3, B=s+E, nu or C_0=128mB^2.
The arithmetic-depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E with leaf bound 8e does not appear; S2.4.6 only asserts the depth is below C_0 d^{C_1}.
The unrolling B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu and A(e)<=8B^2 d^{nu+1} is absent; only the final bound is asserted.

S2.4.6 states the p+Delta / Delta+3 bit reservation and Delta=o(p) from epsilon C_1<1, but omits the induction that a depth-l value lies in 2^{-(p+l)}Z[i] with modulus at most 2^l, which is what links depth to bits.
The plan states every row of H has absolute row sum one, so disks are preserved and the final truncation errs by less than sqrt2 2^{-p}.

summary: P04 carries the binary network computation (B1, B2, B4), the label telescoping and loss ratios (L3, L5), the phase-frame weight additivity and per-vector kernels (P1, P3), the binary rank-deficit chain (R1, R2, R4), the whole matrix-shear lemma (M1-M4) and the disk-preserving truncation (S5): 15 of 26 present. It omits the complex-case coefficients (B3), the residual table and the h-2 side residual (L1, L2), the F_2 orthonormal-basis argument (L4), the odd-weight step and the endpoint repair with Z (P2, P4), eta_c (R3), and the arithmetic-depth constants, recurrence, unrolling and depth-to-bits induction (S1-S4).
